questions.question: What is the correct order of stages in Freytag's Pyramid?
options: Exposition, rising action, climax, falling action, resolution
Climax, exposition, resolution, rising action, falling action
Resolution, falling action, climax, rising action, exposition
Rising action, exposition, falling action, climax, resolution
questions.explanation: Freytag's Pyramid describes plot as exposition, rising action, climax, falling action and resolution.

questions.question: What is a "foil" character?
options: A character who contrasts with the protagonist to highlight their traits
The main villain
A character made of metal
A character who appears only once
questions.explanation: A foil contrasts with the protagonist, making the protagonist's qualities stand out more clearly.

questions.question: What is the difference between a theme and a motif?
options: A theme is an abstract insight; a motif is a concrete, recurring element
A theme is an object; a motif is an idea
They are synonyms
Motifs only appear in poetry
questions.explanation: A theme is stated as an abstract insight about life, while a motif is a recurring concrete element (object, image, phrase) that reinforces the theme.

questions.question: What does it mean when a novel begins "in medias res"?
options: It starts in the middle of the action
It starts with a description of the setting
It starts with the main character's birth
It has two narrators
questions.explanation: "In medias res" is Latin for "into the middle of things" — the story opens mid-action instead of with background exposition.

questions.question: What characterises a "negative" character arc?
options: The character declines or becomes corrupted
The character grows and overcomes a flaw
The character stays the same but changes the world
The character is always evil from the start
questions.explanation: In a negative arc the character declines or is corrupted, in contrast to a positive arc (growth) or a flat arc (unchanged character).
